## Instructions

- Cut vegetables, salt them and let stand overnight.
- Drain and rinse.
- Boil vinegar and sugar; thicken with flour, mustard and turmeric mixed in cold vinegar.
- Add vegetables and cook 45 minutes.
- Bottle in sterilized jars.
